messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT • post-deploy: sharp tail-latency spike + throughput drop observed for runtime pool 'slice-a' after the fast rollout (v2026.3.7). Pager: eng-oncall.

oncall-bot: severity=P1 impact=degraded_throughput latency_p99_up_6x scope=production route=/api/generate footprint=~12% traffic

Tara Wang: I'm on it. Which rollout was this? fast rollout was the 'fast-path-batching' change, right?

Daria Nguyen: yes, rolled at 22:10 UTC — small canary ramp -> immediate traffic shift to slice-a. Customers reporting timeouts and 502s.

Chen Li: looking at runtime logs, I see a cascade of kernel fallbacks and prefetch evictions. snippet: ```
[2026-03-15T22:11:03Z] kernel_fallback: chosen=generic_ppc64 -> reason=unsupported_attention_opt at layer 6
[2026-03-15T22:11:04Z] batch_queue_delay=312ms pending=180
[2026-03-15T22:11:05Z] kvcache_eviction: victim=prefix_agg size=24MB
```

Tara Wang: ack. Could be the new batching heuristics triggering an unoptimized kernel path for long-context requests. Any immediate mitigation?

Kai (infra): suggest flip the fast-rollout feature flag to pause batching changes on slice-a only. Use rflag tool: `rflag set fast_path_batching false --scope=slice-a`

Tara Wang: doing it now. @deploy-bot run?

Deploy-bot: received. Running rollback command against feature toggle. command: `rflag set fast_path_batching false --scope=slice-a --actor=tara`

Deploy-bot: ✅ change accepted. Propagating to 12 instances in slice-a (~4s per instance).

Chen Li: I still see kernel fallback traces on a few hosts but batch_queue_delay is trending down. throughput starting to recover.

Daria Nguyen: Customer impact — top 10 tenants: 3 tenants > 70% of requests saw p95 > 1.5s, 2 tenants saw 502 spikes. Notified support.

Tara Wang: Good. I want a canary rollback on the runtime package too, just to be safe. Which release id? v2026.3.7-release-42

Mike Herrera: I'll take the runtime rollback. Initiating staged rollback to v2026.3.6 on slice-a. Command: `deployctl rollback --slice slice-a --target v2026.3.6 --staged`

Deploy-bot: rollback started — stage=1 (25% traffic)

Tara Wang: Monitor e2e metrics and logs. Set alert annotation: postdeploy-rollback-2026-03-15.

Chen Li: note: batching metrics show abnormal tail while the fast-path was enabled for long tokens (>1024). Might need improved kernel selection in heuristics.

Daria Nguyen: Support published a brief status update to impacted customers. No data loss. Expected restoration timeline ~ 15-30m.

Oncall-bot: status_update: rollback_stage=1 latency_p99 down 40% for slice-a but still above baseline.

Tara Wang: proceed to stage=2 (50%) when p99 < 2x baseline for 5m.

Mike Herrera: stage=2 done. Traffic at 50%. No new 502s.

Chen Li: After stage=2, kernel fallback traces cease on most hosts. I want to capture a repro with a small load test before re-enabling the batching heuristic.

Tara Wang: Agreed. Re-enable only after a targeted test and a fallback policy baked into rollout (auto-kill on p99 > 2x baseline).

Deploy-bot: rollback completed to v2026.3.6 on slice-a. traffic normalized.

Daria Nguyen: Final customer impact: transient degraded latency for ~12% of traffic window (22:10-22:42 UTC), two customers experienced elevated 502 rates, support closed with mitigations and postmortem placeholder.

Tara Wang: I'll start the incident writeup and link to logs + perf graphs. Assigning postmortem owner: @daria_ng.

Daria Nguyen: on it. I will include RKOs, timeline, commands used, and a recommended follow-up: add kernel compatibility checks to rollout gating + extend canary ramp to lower step size when touching batching heuristics.

Mike Herrera: I'm taking first-line for the night — leave me any follow-up actions in the incident doc.

Tara Wang: handing off to @mike_h for overnight monitoring. If p99 increases again, flip `fast_path_batching` globally to false and escalate to infra.

Kai (infra): logged a ticket to add a runtime check that prevents kernel fallback for slices with critical tenants. ticket: INF-4021

oncall-bot: HANDOFF • from=tara to=mike ts=3232100450 notes="rollback complete, customers notified, postmortem assigned to daria" :white_check_mark:

Mike Herrera: thanks — will watch dashboards. Good job team. :thumbsup:
